spec.name: pt_ss_independent_2026
spec.summary: Portugal 2026: monthly social security contribution of a self-employed worker (quarterly regime) from the quarter's declared service/goods income; applies to the declaration month and the next two.

is_eni_or_eirl.description: empresário em nome individual or EIRL holder (or their spouse)

exempt.description: first 12 months, employment exemption, pension, etc.

tax_year.description: the tax year the question is about. This engine has figures for 2026 only; any other year is refused

anchors: pt-social-contributions Example 1: EUR 9,000 services in a quarter -> relevant EUR 6,300, base EUR 2,100, EUR 449.40 a month

rules.name: ENI_EIRL_RATE
rules.quote: Empresário em nome individual, EIRL holder and their spouses | 25.2% | 2026 | Code art. 168(4)

rules.name: SERVICES_FACTOR
rules.quote: Relevant income: services | 70% of the quarter's service income | 2026 | Code art. 162(1)(a)

rules.name: GOODS_FACTOR
rules.quote: Segurança Social computes relevant income: 70% of services plus 20% of goods (art. 162(1))

rules.name: MONTHLY_BASE_FRACTION
rules.quote: Monthly base | 1/3 of the quarter's relevant income, for the declaration month and the next two | 2026 | Code art. 163(1)

rules.name: BASE_CEILING
rules.quote: Ceiling on the monthly base | 12 x IAS = EUR 6,445.56 | 2026 | Code art. 163(5)

rules.name: MIN_CONTRIBUTION
rules.quote: Minimum contribution | EUR 20.00 a month when there is no income or the result is below EUR 20 | 2026 | Code art. 163(2)
